answers.text: "from_52w_hi -36.17 outside the 25 percent band" is Minervini's template, not Elder's test. My screens: W above EMA9, 9>21, 1.5% above swing high; D HH/HL, above EMA9; H1 above EMA9, 95% of range. Tide up, colour left red. Not conceded.

trigger.plain: Price pulls back to within value of the 20-day average with permission still on

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20 less 1 ATR, or elder falls to 6 or less.
decisions.reason: W above EMA9, 9>21, HH/HL; D HH/HL above EMA9; H1 below EMA9 is the dip. elder_5d red gave way, no relapse. Buy under the average, not the plateau.

trigger.plain: Price retraces to the 20-day average with permission still on

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20 less 1 ATR, or elder falls to 6 or less.
decisions.reason: W HH/HL above EMA9, 9>21; elder_5d climbed from a true 0. D is HH but LL and H1 below EMA9: a pullback, not yet a value entry.

decisions.wrong_if: Abstain is wrong if elder_pattern leaves INTERRUPTED and the weekly swing turns HH/HL.
decisions.reason: W swing LH/LL against D HH/HL, elder_pattern INTERRUPTED: trend leg failed on my card. Murky tape, stand aside (C22).

decisions.wrong_if: Abstain is wrong if elder_pattern leaves INTERRUPTED and the daily swing prints HH/HL.
decisions.reason: D swing LH but HL and elder_pattern INTERRUPTED; price 1.4% under the 20-day high, no dip to buy. Stand aside (C22).

trigger.plain: Price eases back to the 20-day average with permission held

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20 less 1 ATR, or elder falls to 6 or less.
decisions.reason: elder_5d red gave way and held at 7; W above EMA9, 9>21. D HH but LL and H1 LH/LL are soft, so only a pullback entry. mp_state FADING is a default label.

trigger.plain: Only a pullback to the 20-day average; ext_atr20 3.72 means no chase

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20 less 1 ATR, or elder falls to 6 or less.
decisions.reason: W HH/HL above EMA9, 9>21; elder_5d pinned plateau is C24 (unsourced), no transition. D swing LH/LL is a flag. Low conviction, pullback only.

trigger.plain: Price pulls back to the 20-day average with permission held

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20 less 1 ATR, or elder falls to 6 or less.
decisions.reason: elder_5d climbed 1 to 7 to 10 with W HH/HL, 2.2% under 20-wk high; ext_atr20 1.4 near value. D swing LH/LL and mp 48.0 are soft.

trigger.plain: Price dips to the 20-day average with permission held

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under ma_20 less 1 ATR, or elder falls to 6 or less.
decisions.reason: W and D both HH/HL above EMA9, 9>21; elder_5d dip bar 4 then 9, 9, 10; D 3.9% under swing high. H1 at 96% of range, so no chase.

declarations: Packet carries no impulse_colour, force_index, price_ema_slope, channel or weekly_trend_direction fields; weekly tide read from the W grid line (above EMA9, 9>21) as a labelled proxy.
